data.name: Prophecy Lost
data.detailed_description:
Prophecy Lost is a PvPvE extraction RPG where every run is a race against time into escalating danger and greater rewards. Each match reshapes the world with procedural map modules—revealing rare bosses, mythic weapons, and unexpected encounters around every corner.

A High-Stakes Fantasy PvPvE Extraction Adventure

Time is running out.

In Prophecy Lost, adventurers venture into a dangerous continent where monsters, rival players, and fate itself stand between you and escape. Every adventure is a race against the clock. Gather powerful weapons, explore an untamed continent, and survive long enough to find a way out.

But when time runs out the match isn’t over yet: the prophecy phase begins. Stick around long enough for a glimpse into the fate of the world, where new dangers—and opportunities—emerge for those who remain.

Prophecy Lost fuses class RPG-style customization and exploration with the high-stakes tension of an extraction game, creating a unique PvPvE experience where every decision matters.

Explore Deeper Match by Match — Risk Grows With Every Step

Journey from region to region through self-contained multiplayer matches, pushing deeper into the world to uncover greater rewards. Prophecy Lost features escalating risk tiers, from safer green regions to deadly yellow and red-level territories where powerful enemies and elite loot await.

The farther you go, the higher the stakes.

Immersive Classes That Fit Your Playstyle

Classes aren't just builds—each class is a character with a past, a role, and a place in the world.

Select from a roster of unique classes—each with distinct weapons, abilities, and ultimate moves that shape how you fight. Whether you prefer crushing foes head-on, controlling the battlefield with magic, or striking from the shadows, mastering your class is key to outlasting both monsters and rival adventurers.

Experiment and utilize the playstyle that strikes joy for you.

Anti-Gear Fear Design — The Encyclopedia Remembers Your Loot

Afraid of losing your loot? Fear not!

Extracted weapons, items, and accessories are permanently registered in your Encyclopedia. Once unlocked, gear can be repurchased/reforged in future expeditions—encouraging bold plays instead of cautious hoarding.

Risk powerful equipment. Chase greater rewards.

Procedural Map Modules Create a Classic Dungeon Crawl Experience

No two runs are the same.

Wilderness matches have rearranged layouts, loot, monsters, and points of interest, creating unpredictable encounters and risks. From claustrophobic corridors to sprawling valleys filled with danger and treasure, exploration stays interesting with new monsters, loot, discoveries around every corner.

data.short_description: Prophecy Lost is an extraction RPG where loot is more than just gear: extract with pets, companions, abilities and more. What you take out shapes both gameplay and the unfolding story. Each match escalates toward a catastrophic calamity event—escape before the prophecy brings the world to ruin.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5-4460 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 380 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
